#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    int v, w, x, y, z;
    Point(int v, int w, int x, int y, int z) : v(v), w(w), x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
    double mag() const {
        return sqrt(v*v + w*w + x*x + y*y + z*z);
    }
};

bool angle(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    double amag = a.mag();
    double bmag = b.mag();
    double abmag = a.v * b.v + a.w * b.w + a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
    double cosine = abmag / (amag * bmag);
    // Clamp cosine to [-1, 1] to avoid floating point errors
    if (cosine > 1.0) cosine = 1.0;
    if (cosine < -1.0) cosine = -1.0;
    double angle_deg = acos(cosine) * 180.0 / M_PI;
    return angle_deg < 90.0;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int a, b, c, d, e;
        cin >> a >> b >> c >> d >> e;
        points.emplace_back(a, b, c, d, e);
    }

    unordered_set<int> goodIndices;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        bool isGood = true;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                if (i != j && i != k && j != k) {
                    Point one = points[j];
                    Point two = points[k];
                    Point three = points[i];
                    Point lol2(one.v - three.v, one.w - three.w, one.x - three.x, one.y - three.y, one.z - three.z);
                    Point lol1(two.v - three.v, two.w - three.w, two.x - three.x, two.y - three.y, two.z - three.z);
                    if (angle(lol1, lol2)) {
                        isGood = false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (isGood) {
            goodIndices.insert(i + 1);
        }
    }

    if (goodIndices.empty()) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << goodIndices.size() << "\n";
        for (int idx : goodIndices) {
            cout << idx << "\n";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
